Settings driven by the product's config catalog: typed controls, categories, search above twelve rows, provenance as text, locked rows set by an organization, and reset. A locked setting shows its value as text with a lock, never as a dimmed control.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-python" />

    **Drop-in.** `config` (`list`, `get`, `set`, `reset`).

    **Styled part.** `screens.settings(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `settings_view(entries, local)` → `SettingsView` in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Node)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-node" />

    **Drop-in.** `config list` (`configListFlow`): each setting, its value and where it comes from,
    with the operator's locked ones marked (`list`, `locked`); `config get <key>`,
    `config set <key> <value>` and `config reset <key>` (`saving`). `secret <key>` and
    `mint <recipeId>` print a value alone, for scripts.

    **Styled part.** `tableRows`.

    **Headless.** None of its own: the data is `client.config.listUserConfig()` and
    `client.config.getConfigSource(key)`.

    [Terminal (Node)](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/terminal-node/) has the adapter's options, the
    `--json` contract and the fallbacks.

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
